name: Mrs. F. H. Ertel
role: Wife of Fred Ertel of Belfield
bio: Mrs. Fred Ertel of Belfield hosted the editor and joined social gatherings in 1884. In August 1884 she left Belfield with her children for St. Louis.

moments.label: Left Belfield with her children for St. Louis

mentions: …t this fact, however, is wonderfully tempered by the remembrance of the pleasant evening spent with Mrs. Fred Ertel and Miss Nellie Dailie, at Belfield.

…good time. There is no better hall west of Fargo and each participant made the best of the opportunity. Mrs. Ertel and Miss Dallie, of Belfield were present, besides Miss Friedman, Lloyd and Mrs. Roberts from up the river.
Mrs. F. H. Ertel and children bid adieu to Belfield on Sunday last, and will remain at St. Louis for the present.
